4th Period.workingNow: Reading your CSS Quick Reference to add padding and margin around your images or headings.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your About Me page with an external CSS stylesheet linked — custom fonts/colors, class/ID selectors, padding/margin, and an organized layout — pushed and ready to submit Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can apply padding and margin so that my page's elements have breathing room instead of feeling cramped.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: Hand out CSS Quick Reference sheet (3 min)
I do: model adding padding to one box (6 min)
You do: add padding or margin to at least two elements (17 min)
Exit Ticket: paste one padding or margin rule (4 min)
4th Period.connections: Since it's a short day, we keep it simple: use your new reference sheet to add breathing room around a couple of elements with padding and margin. Tomorrow we look at arranging elements on the page.
